bricks G4 — validation mint results

13 of 18 spec frames verified, 3 parked, 2 never generated (gate-held on parked cards) — plus 2 frames that only came into existence mid-run (the line-worker canonical and L46's card), for 14 stamped-verified frames in total. Total spend $0.780 of the $5.00 hard cap, 20 gens, 0 transport failures, 0 provider 503s. Validated live (not just derived from code): P2 new-cast routing (the line-worker mint), P3's review gate including a live refusal-then-release demo on L46, P4 crowd-tier routing (isolated on L169, combined with named cast on L46), P12's veto holding (both vetoed expressions stayed FAIL in the store), and C-1's retry-name guard (L169 held on its plate alone despite an exempt-looking label).

The question this mint was built to answer: did the Phase-3 doctrine changes (P2, P3, P4, P8–P12, C-1, C-11) actually recover the taste axes Daniel marked wrong on the 6c2 board — not just pass code review, but produce pixels he would have named? Ten slice beats were re-generated under the new doctrine and judged by two disjoint sonnet verifier pairs per round (any fail on either axis set fails the frame). The answer is mixed on purpose: 7 of 10 scenes came back clean, and the 3 that didn't each isolate a specific, named doctrine gap rather than a generic miss.

Defect exhibit 1 — P8's pose regression

Both parked cards came back in the canonical's default upright standing pose. Neither retry (the sanctioned P10 pose path, with an explicit corrective instruction) moved the body. Shown against their pose references and against L46's card — the same hold-both-hands primitive, which landed perfectly the first time.
The mechanism. P8 correctly identified that stance prose sitting next to a named pose re-poses the card, and removed it from L39 and L48's beat sentences (L48: “with his shoulders down” deleted; L39: sentence re-composed to remove the act words entirely). But beat_clause reads that sentence to build the card's payload — with no act text left in the clause, the card is minted against a pose reference image alone, and the reference alone does not reliably transfer posture. P10's retry lever cannot recover it, because _retry_step1 rebuilds the card from the same recipe that just failed.

The evidence is controlled, not anecdotal: every beat whose figure sentence kept its act words landed its pose 4 for 4 (L29 powerstance, L38 armscrossed, L38 offering, L44 thumbsdown, all untouched by the 9a re-author) — against 0 for 2 on the beats whose act words were stripped (L39, L48), and 0 for 2 again on retry. L46 is the decisive control: the identical hold-both-hands primitive that failed twice on miniscribe-rep landed first try on line-worker, and the only relevant difference is that L46's prose kept its act words (“carrying a cardboard box of desk things…”).

Recommendation: P8 needs a follow-up. Removing re-posing prose is right; removing the act itself is not — either keep the act clause and strip only stance/posture adjectives, or have figure_card_payload state the pose primitive's posture in words when the clause carries none.

Defect exhibit 2 — P9 is half a fix (L34)

L34 authors no expression change (“only this changes: …a queue of loaded pallets… everything else exactly as established”), built as a delta off the VERIFIED L33 parent. Measured against L33 by region (per-pixel RGB sum-delta > 30):

Verdict: P9 is half a fix. The 6c2 park was diagnosed as “seed_roles never states which seed owns expression”. P9 added that statement, and the hair/identity half of the leak closed almost completely (37.58% → 6.51%). The EXPRESSION half did not close (29.79% → 43.70%, actually larger than the 6c2 baseline) — eyes went from a closed happy squint to wide open with visible pupils, mouth from an open grin to a small closed smile, while ibm-suit resolved the identical spec correctly. The same character-asymmetry 6c2 recorded. P9's seed-role prose is already in the assembled prompt, so the residual gap is spec-side, not a generator lottery. Deliberately not retried — place, ibm-suit and the authored door-to-queue delta are all correct here, and a re-roll risks all three to fix one face; candidate left at _staging/L34.png, not promoted.

Parked, with mechanism

  • L39's card (hold-both-hands) — P8 regression: act words stripped from the beat sentence during 9a's re-author → beat_clause carries no act text → the pose reference alone does not transfer posture. 1 sanctioned retry, still failed. Scene never generated (gate held it on the parked card).
  • L48's card (action-slump) — same mechanism as L39; “with his shoulders down” deleted from the beat sentence. 1 sanctioned retry, still failed. Scene never generated.
  • L34 (scene) — P9 half-landed: the hair/identity leak closed (37.58%→6.51%) but the expression leak did not (29.79%→43.70%, worse than the 6c2 baseline). Deliberately not retried — place, ibm-suit and the authored delta are all correct and a re-roll would risk all three to fix one face. Candidate left at _staging/L34.png, not promoted.

Also worth carrying forward (from the report)

  • A sliced batch silently drops the place plate unless the minting shot is included in the same scope (found rebuilding L46: --shots L46 alone dropped the plate seed silently; --shots L28,L46 fixed it). Should refuse or warn, not silently mint place-less.
  • A sonnet verifier hallucinated a reference image once (B failed L46 on place-continuity describing a plate that matches no file in the kit); caught only because the disjoint pair disagreed with itself, overturned by a fresh adjudicator. The general risk — a verifier that mis-reads the reference can fail silently in the PASS direction too — is unaddressed.
  • ~17 scene-manifest rows outside this slice still read verified against PNGs that do not exist in this checkout (the same hazard L48's stale row had, now corrected); needs a sweep before any render. L169's own manifest entry carries file: null despite a verified PNG on disk.
Boss recommendation — G4: RECOVERED, with one bounded fix. The taste axes you ruled on came back: named casting replaced the cream performers (P2, live-refused at $0), every seeding asset passed a real gate (P3, demonstrated live), crowds routed your head-tone/dress amendments (P4), both vetoed expressions are unmintable (P12), and the L28 plate reads as a working set. 13/18 verified at $0.78. The two parks are one mechanism each: (1) P8 — beats re-authored to compose-from-primitives lost their act TEXT, and a pose reference image alone doesn't move the body (4/4 controls vs 0/2, decisive same-primitive isolate on L46). Proposed fix, one function: when prose names a primitive in backticks, beat_clause derives the act text from that primitive — doctrine unchanged, clause carries the act; then re-mint 2 cards + 2 scenes (~$0.16). (2) P9 — the delta face fix landed the hair half, not the face interior; role prose is correct in the payload, the provider ignores half of it — recommend accepting as a render-side iteration item for the next wave, not a blocker. Asks: rule the P8 fix (yes/no), rule P9 acceptance, and on yes+yes: unfreeze 6c3 and merge the branch.
